headline: Aquarium and State Park Entry Management
reservation: The Monterey Bay Aquarium requires specific date-based entry; check their official site for current ticketing requirements. Point Lobos State Natural Reserve uses a capacity-based parking system that fills early; verify if a reservation or specific arrival window is required before visiting.

days.title: Marine Life and Historic Cannery Row

stops.name: Monterey Bay Aquarium
stops.detail: Explore deep-sea kelp forest exhibits and local marine life in this world-renowned research facility.

stops.name: Monterey Bay Coastal Recreation Trail
stops.detail: Walk the waterfront path toward Fisherman's Wharf to spot sea otters in the kelp beds.

days.driving: Allow walking for the day; local transfers vary by traffic
days.note: Pedestrians and cyclists share the trail; stay to the designated lanes.

days.title: Wildflowers and Coastal Overlooks

stops.name: Point Lobos State Natural Reserve
stops.detail: Hike through Monterey cypress groves and scan the coves for harbor seals.

stops.name: Lovers Point Park
stops.detail: Relax at this Pacific Grove landmark known for its unique east-facing coastal views.

days.driving: Allow 45 minutes; Highway 1 traffic fluctuates near Carmel
days.note: Arrive at Point Lobos early; parking frequently reaches capacity before noon.

days.title: Adobe History and Bay Views
days.start: Suggested: 10 AM at Monterey State Historic Park

stops.name: Monterey State Historic Park
stops.detail: Tour the collection of historic adobe buildings that served as California's first capital.

stops.name: Old Fisherman's Wharf
stops.detail: Visit the pier for views of the harbor and to watch sea lions congregating on the structures.

days.driving: Allow 10 minutes; walking within the historic district is recommended
days.note: Check official park schedules for specific adobe building tour times.

intel.title: Aquarium and Wharf Garages
intel.text: Use the Cannery Row parking garage for aquarium visits to avoid street meters. Point Lobos parking is extremely limited; have a backup plan if the lot is closed.

intel.title: Coastal Dead Zones
intel.text: Expect limited signal along sections of Highway 1 south of Carmel. Download trail maps for Point Lobos and 17-Mile Drive in advance.

intel.title: Peninsula Services
intel.text: Fuel is widely available in Monterey and Seaside but becomes expensive and rare as you head south toward Big Sur. Refill before departing the Monterey city limits.

intel.title: Fog and Visibility
intel.text: Marine layers often obscure coastal views until midday during summer months. Schedule indoor activities like the aquarium for misty mornings.

intel.title: Trail Safety
intel.text: Keep back from cliff edges and stay on designated paths at Point Lobos to protect sensitive flora. Never approach or feed the sea otters or seals.

plan.arrival: Pick up rental at Monterey Regional Airport (MRY); check into waterfront lodging before walking the recreation trail.
plan.vehicle: Standard cars are ideal for the peninsula; check for parking height restrictions in Cannery Row garages if using an RV.
plan.goldenHour: Lovers Point for sunrise or Asilomar State Beach for sunset; seasonal fog may impact visibility.
